signals: To develop the first round of Economic Justice funding, we combined research with engagement across the sector. This included conversations with more than 20 key sector organisations, in-depth discussions with more than eight funders and a staff workshop with Partners for a Ne…
added: To develop the first round of Economic Justice funding, we combined research with engagement across the sector. This included conversations with more than 20 key sector organisations, in-depth discussions with more than eight funders and a staff workshop with Partners for a New Economy.

We also commissioned People’s Economy to help us map community-rooted organisations working on economic justice across London. They also carried out 15 in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with organisations representing different communities and experiences of economic injustice.
This feedback directly shaped the programme design, including our focus on community power, lived experience leadership, peer learning and sector networks.
